Maya Chen: hey everyone, day 2 here — quick question: where's the right place to post laptop/VPN/setup issues? is #help the IT queue or should i open a ticket elsewhere? :wave:
Diego Rivera: welcome Maya! :tada: Post hardware/IT requests in #help — that channel forwards to IT's ticketing queue. if it's urgent, ping @Avery (IT).
Priya Sinha: also FYI for onboarding-specific questions use #new-hires or DM @OnboardBot — we have a pinned checklist there with the common first-week items.
Maya Chen: got it, thanks. is there a recommended format for the ticket? i don't want to paste anything sensitive into the channel.
Jess (DevEx): short answer: put minimal non-sensitive info in the channel and open the ticket for anything with serials/credentials. example: "Laptop: won't join VPN, macOS 13.4, wired -> tried reboot, error 403" and then add the ticket link. always use a thread for follow-ups. :+1:
OnboardBot: Hi Maya! I can open the ticket for you. Use `/onboard ticket "Laptop won't connect to VPN"` or say `@OnboardBot open ticket` and include a brief description. For VPN diagnostics, run:
```
# on mac/linux run:
openconnect --version  # or 
scutil --get ComputerName
```
and paste non-sensitive outputs into the ticket.
Avery (IT): quick heads-up — if you need a hardware swap, include the device serial number and your office location. don't post any passwords. we can pick up on-site same-day if it's flagged urgent.
Sam K: channel etiquette tip: use #help for IT, #eng-infra for infra/config questions, #product for product/feature questions, and #new-hires for intros and onboarding chatter. DMs are fine for 1:1s. threads > new messages in the base channel when it's follow-ups.
Priya Sinha: also we use reactions to ack work: :eyes: means looking, :white_check_mark: means resolved. please check pinned messages before posting — we try to avoid duplicates.
Maya Chen: perfect — i'll use #help and run the onboard bot command now. thanks y'all! :smile:
Jess (DevEx): one last note — if you're ever unsure, drop the minimal question in #new-hires and tag the relevant owner, folks will point you to the right channel. welcome aboard again! :sparkles:
